## qualityGradient() function

A blue→red gradient over a 0–1 score, for any per-column or per-residue quality/conservation metric. Desaturated and darkened in dark mode so it doesn't glare against a dark background.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function qualityGradient(score: number, darkMode?: boolean): string;
```
